_comment: Evaluation configuration for the six-worker scaled testbed (one worker per device: agx-0, nx-0..nx-3, pi5-0). Scheduling and runtime parameters take their code defaults except where workload_env sets one; otherwise this file names the testbed topology and the per-workload load settings that each figure was measured with.
_workload_env: Runtime switches set for one workload in every plan. W1 and W3: placement rests on the start-up probe alone (HEDICES_EFF=0, no worker-level efficiency correction); the correction measured during warm-up varies from run to run and with it the layout full settles on.
_dask_env: Operator tuning of the Dask baseline (scheduler and workers): work stealing off; it moved the small fused tasks between workers (W1 54.6 -> 47.3 ms, W2-W4 unchanged within 2 %; results/qd3).
_e10: Closed-loop concurrency of the end-to-end comparison, the same for every system. The levels were chosen from a sweep (W1: 3,4,6,8,10; W2: 2-6; W4: 3,4,5; see AGENTS.md) as the ones where the ratio to Ray is closest to the reference; the ablation (e6) keeps its own levels.
_e6: Fig 6 (plan e6). cache_entries: function-cache capacity per device class, or for one worker (its own entry wins). segment_mix 1,2: W4 instances alternate one and two camera frames. warm_seq: the warm-up opens with that many instances run one at a time. cache_evict: replacement policy of a full function cache (Branch --cache-evict). env: scheduler settings of the run -- HEDICES_STATIC_LIGHT names the light stages of the static / nocache deployment plan, HEDICES_CHAIN_MARGIN_MS the margin within which full keeps a successor on its predecessor's worker, HEDICES_ALPHA0_BLIND the share of alpha0's deployment cost priced by the probes rather than the cache contents.
_e7: Fig 7 (plan e7): dispatch distribution per device class; these settings override the Fig 6 ones of the workload. full and alpha0 are pooled over a closed-loop load sweep (repro/run_all.sh fig7; load_sweep lists a workload's levels, default 2-5). alpha0 here is full without the alignment reward, the eviction cost and the declared-tier preference (ALPHA0_TIER_FREE), with its deployment amortized like full's (AMORT_ALL) and priced by the probes (ALPHA0_BLIND; ALPHA0_BLIND_AMORT also for the amortization); a successor riding its predecessor's dispatch is charged 0.1 of a deployment (CHAIN_DEDUP). HEDICES_STATIC_HEAVY_MS: the static / nocache plan places a model stage of at least that mean execution time on the most capable device class. cpu_max_khz: CPU frequency cap of a device class while this workload's Fig 7 runs (testbed/cpufreq.sh; restored afterwards).
_e13: Fig 13 (plan e13): worker failures per system (trials), and each trial's warm-up and measurement window (s). settle_first_s: the first trial waits for a freshly deployed cluster to converge; settle_after_s: the later trials start from the steady state the previous trial left and only wait for the pods replaced after its failure (the full settle on every trial was most of this step's wall clock; the Knative autoscaler's pod set never stops changing, so it always ran to the cap).  session: the systems that take several failures in one run (started and warmed up once; Ray, whose node cut off past its health check is declared dead for good, starts afresh for every failure), at most session_trials per run; each failure is recorded as a one-failure run records it (the link down at least to the end of its measurement window, then until no instance stalls for quiet_s; gap_s of normal load before the next one).
